comparison.objective: Cut copper tubing on a mark without denting or spiraling the cut.
comparison.physical_skill: Tool orbiting, incremental screw feed, regrasping and bimanual handoff.
comparison.success_condition: Tube cut through on-mark and round, cutter released; excessive bite or cut error penalized. No material rubric detail missing.
comparison.reason: Tests cyclic cutting-tool control and feed management, not sifting, retention or support reseating.
